messages:
marta (People Ops): Quick idea: set up a rotating "Recognition Kiosk" in the foyer for two weeks after each release. Managers can drop by to pick pre-packaged spot-award envelopes for hand-delivery. Low-touch distribution, more personal than desk drops. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

kevin (People Ops): love it. logistics q: how many envelopes per release?

marta (People Ops): proposal: starter kit = 40 envelopes (mix of $25 e-code + thank-you card + sticker). Keep 20 reserve. Budget estimate ~$22/kit.

tasha (HR): policy check: ensure gift value under $50 to avoid income reporting. Also we should include short usage guidance card for managers (non-promissory language).

leo (Facilities): kiosk can be a rolling cart near reception. I'll reserve space and add signage. Need storage lock for off-hours.

finance-bot: FYI: purchases above $750 need department head approval. Estimated run cost for 60 kits ~ $1,320. Please submit expense request early.

kevin (People Ops): could we rotate some non-monetary swag to reduce cost? enamel pins, stickers, handwritten notes?

marta (People Ops): yes — hybrid kits: 30 e-code kits + 30 swag kits. That brings estimate down to ~$800. Good compromise.

tasha (HR): approve wording for the card: "Thanks for going above and beyond. This small token celebrates your contribution, from the Redwood team." Keep it generic.

kevin (People Ops): volunteers for staffing kiosk midday? 2 volunteers per lunch window should cover it. I'll add sign-up in the sheet.

leo (Facilities): note: delivery window from vendor is 910am. I'll coordinate a locked box for overnight storage.

marta (People Ops): action items: kevin to update budget sheet and submit expense, leo to reserve kiosk spot & lockbox, tasha to attach approved card copy to the doc. We'll pilot after next release. Thanks all :raised_hands:
